title: Grim Reaper Execution
description: A dark surreal painting displayed on a grimy studio wall depicts the Grim Reaper plunging a burning skeletal hand into a screaming man's skull, causing explosive blood and brain matter to spray outward. The studio contains a wooden desk with scattered tools, a radio, papers, a jacket on a chair, and an illuminated red EXIT sign above a doorway under dim overhead lighting.
prompt: Interior of a dimly lit, grimy artist studio at night with rain on the windows, a large dark surreal painting hanging on the wall showing the Grim Reaper in a tattered robe with glowing skeletal torso reaching into a screaming victim's head with a burning hand causing blood and brain to explode violently, red blood splatter dripping down the wall and floor, wooden desk in foreground with tools radio and papers, red exit sign above a door, cinematic horror atmosphere, detailed textures, moody lighting
